laLoungeCustomFurniture.title: Custom Furniture Manufacturing
laLoungeCustomFurniture.subtitle: Bespoke furniture crafted to your exact specifications: from the first concept sketch to the final installation on your event floor.

process.title: Our Manufacturing Process
process.subtitle: Five meticulous steps that turn a sketch into a finished piece

s1.title: Planning & Design
s1.desc: We sit with you to understand the vision, the venue, and the mood. Our designers translate that brief into detailed concept sketches, 3D renders, and material mood boards for your approval.

s2.title: Material Selection
s2.desc: From solid walnut to brushed brass, from velvet to acrylic: we present a curated palette of premium materials and finishes, each chosen to match your design intent and budget.

s3.title: Manufacturing
s3.desc: Our master craftsmen build every piece by hand in our Kuwait workshop. Welding, joinery, upholstery, and finishing are carried out under one roof for full quality control.

s4.title: Quality Control
s4.desc: Every piece passes a multi-point inspection: structural integrity, finish uniformity, dimensions, and weight capacity: before it is signed off for delivery.

s5.title: Delivery & Installation
s5.desc: White-glove delivery to your venue, on-site assembly by our installation crew, and final positioning per your floor plan. We stay until every piece is exactly where it should be.

laLoungeEventPlanning.title: Complete Event Planning & Execution
laLoungeEventPlanning.subtitle: From the first concept conversation to the last guest leaving: we plan, build, and execute your event in full, so every detail lands exactly as it should.

process.title: Our Planning Process
process.subtitle: Five phases that take your event from idea to aftermath

s1.title: Initial Consultation
s1.desc: A deep-dive session to understand your goals, audience, budget, and aesthetic. We listen first, then advise on what is achievable and where to invest for impact.

s2.title: Concept Development
s2.desc: We translate the brief into a creative direction: theme, colour story, mood boards, and a high-level event flow. You sign off on the creative before we move on.

s3.title: Detailed Planning
s3.desc: Floor plans, vendor sourcing, run-of-show, logistics, permits, and a production schedule. Every decision is documented, costed, and aligned with the signed-off concept.

s4.title: Execution
s4.desc: On event day, our production crew runs the show: setup, talent coordination, guest flow, and teardown. You host; we manage the backstage.

s5.title: Post-Event
s5.desc: Settlement with vendors, photography delivery, feedback review, and an archived playbook so your next event starts from a stronger baseline.
